name: geograph2-spatial-ecology
description: Clean-Room GeoGraph 2.0 MCP Agent Skill for spatial habitat connectivity, equal-area spherical DGGS, RSP adjoint sensitivity, and GBF 30x30 policy auditing.

geo_contract.distance_units: meters (m) or kilometers (km) via spherical Haversine

tools.name: geograph2.audit_30x30
tools.description: Run a Kunming-Montreal GBF Target 3 (30x30) policy connectivity audit on a GraphJSON habitat network.

tools.name: geograph2.solve_rsp_adjoint
tools.description: Compute RSP expected hitting cost and analytical adjoint sensitivities (dK/dq, dK/dP, dK/dC).

tools.name: geograph2.build_spherical_dggs
tools.description: Generate an equal-area spherical hexagonal DGGS topology (<0.5% area distortion) over a lon/lat bounding box.

tools.name: geograph2.run_case_study
tools.description: Execute one of the built-in reproducible offline ecological case studies.
